$description: popBrass (orchestral pop brass) pattern bank. Per-genre style pick (legacy config.json#defaultStyleMappings.brassPatterns) then a uniform pick over the style's pattern bank. Each pattern emits `noteRelative` events (distanceFromMiddleC = note.position + duration). The 'schlager' style is a schlager signature (legacy brassPatterns schlager=[schlager]).
$genreStylesNote: docs/62 A5 (06-20): casperaki2 actively rosters+plays brass in latin and organicVibes too, mapping both to the genre-independent StefanSchlagerPatterns stabs (c2 config brassPatterns latin=[library,libraryStabs], organicVibes=[libraryStabs]; LibraryBrass loads the same bank regardless of genre). c1 was schlager-only. We follow c2 (canonical) and point latin/organicVibes at the existing `schlager` style/bank (no new data). (c2's latin also has a `library` style that throws ~half the time — an upstream bug we intentionally do NOT reproduce.)
